title: 第 708章 所要雷火第 707章 进入古妖秘境
slug: 残鼎复元陆家修仙崛起路
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：残鼎复元：陆家修仙崛起路第一卷：默认第708章所要雷火（..la）陆行舟见状，剑诀变幻，被震飞的法剑瞬间朝着不同方位飞去，将双头蟒困在剑阵中，层层剑气不断切割着蟒身。
双头蟒眼中满是不屑，喷出一大片寒气，化作一个冰墙将自己包裹住，喷出的毒液让剑气全都化作破碎的灵光。
它巨大蟒尾凝聚出万钧之力，甩向困住它的法剑。
陆行舟冷哼一声，双手结印，法剑骤然改变方位，避开横扫的蟒尾，同时剑气凝聚出数六把巨剑虚影，从不同方向劈落。
巨剑碰到毒液灵力变得暗淡，可法剑源源不断飞出的剑气又让其变得灵力。
“给我破。”
陆行舟低喝一声，朝着法剑打入数道法诀，法剑爆发出璀璨光芒。
巨剑虚影悍然冲破毒雾的包裹，势如破竹，轰然劈在厚实冰墙之上。
“咔嚓”
冰墙瞬间崩裂，化作漫天细碎冰晶，四散纷飞。
趁此时机，陆行舟身形一动，再次欺近，手中黑色斧刃猛的劈落在之前破开的鳞甲伤口处。
斧刃深深嵌入血肉，直接劈开蟒身肌理，重创其经脉要害。
“嘶！”
双头蟒发出一声凄厉至极的惨叫，庞大身躯剧烈抽搐扭动，猩红鲜血喷射而出，眼中满是惊恐之色。
双头蟒嘶吼着挣扎，冰锥与毒雾胡乱喷吐，只在林间炸出一个个大坑。
陆行舟身形不断闪烁，手中斧刃连续劈落，每一击都精准落在创伤要害处。
他再次抬手劈落，这次骨骼崩断，两颗巨大狰狞的蟒首同时齐根而断，重重砸落在地。
庞大的蟒躯抽搐了几下，最终彻底瘫软倒地，没了气息。
陆行舟重重的松了口气，这一战虽不算艰难，却也消耗不小。
他扫了一眼双头蟒的尸体，四阶中期的妖兽，全身都是宝，鳞甲、毒牙可炼器，毒囊可给幽冥天蝎使用……

他正要收取尸体，一道戏谑的声音忽然从暗处传来，语气中带着几分玩味：
“啧啧，没想到一个元婴初期修士，居然能灭杀一只四阶中期妖兽，这等实力可真是少见。”
“还有，你胆子不小，一个人类修士，居然敢隐匿身形闯入了我妖族秘境。”
陆行舟身形猛地一僵，手中黑斧下意识握紧，神识朝四周扩散，却竟然没有捕捉到任何气息。
他心下一沉，表面却不露分毫，冷冷开口：“道友藏头露尾，究竟是何人？意欲何为？”
话音落下的瞬间，一道灵光在不远处闪烁，光芒散去后，一名身着金色长袍的男子出现在百丈之外。
那人面容俊朗，双眼竟是淡金色的竖瞳，周身散发着元婴后期气息。
此时正是他之前见过，所有妖修都对他神色恭敬的男子。
男子淡然开口道：“原本不打算理会你的，不过道友刚才祭出的灵火有些意思，交出来吧，放你一条生路。”
陆行舟闻言，挥手将双头蟒庞大的尸体收了起来，轻笑一声：“好大的口气，就是不知道，你的实力配不配得上这话，道友若想在这危机四伏的秘境中与我缠斗一番，我自是奉陪。”
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: The Restoration of the Broken Cauldron: The Road to the Lu Family’s Rise to Immortality Volume 1: Default Chapter 708 The Thunder Fire (..la) Seeing this, Lu Xingzhou’s sword tactics changed, and the knocked-off magic sword instantly flew in different directions, trapping the two-headed python in the sword formation, and layers of sword energy continued to cut the python’s body.
The two-headed python's eyes were full of disdain, and it spewed out a large amount of cold air, turning into an ice wall to wrap itself up. The venom it sprayed turned all the sword energy into broken spiritual light.
Its huge python tail gathered a huge amount of power and threw it towards the magic sword that trapped it.
Lu Xingzhou snorted coldly, formed seals with his hands, and the magic sword suddenly changed its direction to avoid the sweeping python tail. At the same time, the sword energy condensed into six shadows of giant swords, which fell from different directions.
The giant sword's spiritual power became dim when it encountered the venom, but the sword energy that continuously flew out of the magic sword made it become spiritual again.
"Break it for me."
Lu Xingzhou shouted low and fired several magic spells into the magic sword, and the magic sword burst out with bright light.
The phantom of the giant sword broke through the poisonous mist and smashed into the thick ice wall like a bamboo.
"Click"
The ice wall instantly cracked and turned into fine ice crystals that scattered all over the sky.
Taking advantage of this opportunity, Lu Xingzhou moved and approached again. The black ax blade in his hand struck hard at the scale wound that had been broken before.
The ax blade was deeply embedded in the flesh and blood, directly splitting the texture of the python's body and severely damaging its vital meridians.
"Hiss!"
The two-headed python let out a shrill scream, its huge body twitched and twisted violently, scarlet blood spurted out, and its eyes were full of horror.
The two-headed python roared and struggled, spitting ice picks and poisonous mist randomly, only to explode into large craters in the forest.
Lu Xingzhou's figure kept flashing, and the ax blade in his hand fell continuously, and each blow accurately landed on the vital part of the wound.
He raised his hand to chop it down again, and this time the bones broke. Two huge and ferocious python heads were broken off at the same time and fell heavily to the ground.
The huge python's body twitched several times, and finally fell completely limp and breathless.
Lu Xingzhou breathed a sigh of relief. Although this battle was not difficult, it was also quite draining.
He glanced at the body of the two-headed python. It was a mid-level fourth-level monster with treasures all over its body. Its scales and fangs could be used to refine weapons, and its poison sacs could be used by Netherworld Scorpions...
Just as he was about to collect the body, a joking voice suddenly came from the darkness, with a hint of playfulness in his tone:
"Tsk, tsk, I didn't expect that a monk in the early stage of Nascent Soul could actually kill a mid-level fourth-order monster. Such strength is really rare."
"Also, you are very courageous. A human monk actually dared to hide himself and break into the secret realm of our demon clan."
Lu Xingzhou stiffened suddenly, subconsciously clenching the black ax in his hand, and his consciousness spread around, but he didn't catch any breath.
His heart sank, but he didn't reveal anything on the surface, and said coldly: "Fellow Taoist, who hides his head and shows his tail, who is he? What do you want?"
The moment the words fell, a spiritual light flickered not far away. After the light dissipated, a man in a golden robe appeared a hundred feet away.
The man had a handsome face, his eyes had pale golden vertical pupils, and his whole body exuded the aura of the late Nascent Soul.
At this time, it was the man he had seen before, and all the demon cultivators looked respectful to him.
The man said calmly: "I didn't plan to pay attention to you at first, but the spiritual fire that fellow Taoist sacrificed just now is interesting. Hand it over and let you live."
Hearing this, Lu Xingzhou waved his hand to put away the huge body of the two-headed python, and chuckled: "That's a big statement, but I don't know if your strength is worthy of these words. If fellow Taoist want to fight with me in this dangerous secret realm, I will definitely accompany you."
